title.narrative: Percentage of SDF beneficiaries in wage or self-employment at least 6-12 months after graduation (by target district, female and male, disability, economic sector, and SDF window).

comment.narrative: RTB has enrolled 15,495 SDF trainees including 7127 females and 8368 males. These are undergoing training by both private (75%) and public (25%) institutions. The first cohort of SDF trainees is expected to graduate in November 2025 and their employment will be traced after 6 months, in July 26.
